title: JazzHR integration (ATS & HRMS) | Xobin
text:
About JazzHR
JazzHR is an applicant tracking system built for small and mid-sized teams. It helps recruiters post jobs, organise applicants, collaborate with hiring managers and move candidates through a structured pipeline without heavy administration.
Why integrate JazzHR with Xobin?
Integrating JazzHR with Xobin streamlines your recruitment process by combining powerful applicant tracking with advanced skill assessments. You can send customised assessments directly from JazzHR while results sync back in real time for easy candidate evaluation. By pairing Xobin's AI-driven assessments with JazzHR's candidate management, you make data-backed decisions faster and select the best-fit candidates with minimal effort.

Analyse candidate performance
The detailed Xobin report includes:

Who is this integration for?
The JazzHR and Xobin integration is ideal for HR professionals, recruiters and talent acquisition teams who want to strengthen their hiring process. It is particularly useful for organisations that want to streamline candidate assessments, automate workflows and make data-driven hiring decisions. Whether you are a small business or a large enterprise, it helps you manage applications while ensuring thorough, efficient skill evaluation for every candidate.
Capabilities
Features & benefits
Assessments from the candidate profile
Send a Xobin assessment straight from the candidate's Assessments tab in JazzHR, with an optional custom email body or template.
Single API key setup
Generate one key in Xobin Settings > Integrations and paste it into the Xobin app in JazzHR to connect both platforms.
Automatic result sync
Completion status, date and total score are written back to the candidate record in JazzHR as soon as the test is submitted.
Detailed skill reporting
Click View Details for Xobin's full report with skill-by-skill analysis, section and question-level scores and the candidate log.
No context switching
Send tests, track completion and read scores without ever leaving the JazzHR candidate profile.
Same-day shortlisting
Total scores appear on the record as soon as a candidate submits, so screening decisions do not wait.
